scope: Independent30s diagnostic, not primary wall comparison or complete original-USDC analysis. Completed check clock cost excludes encoding/model extraction/context teardown; interrupted snapshot is lower-bound cost. Slow SMT serialization overhead outside native check clock.

native_solver_cost.scope: Completed intercepted native checks only; encoding, model extraction and context cleanup excluded. Interrupted/in-flight calls and activity after the last snapshot are excluded; cost is then a lower bound.

probe_verification.scope: Independent two-query interception verification; this is not an EVM benchmark. Per-completed-check and periodic atomic snapshots survive owned server SIGTERM; interrupted CPU/time sums exclude unfinished native checks and may omit checks after last snapshot.
probe_verification.slow_query_dump_scope: Optional EVM_Z3_SLOW_QUERY_PREFIX; dump only completed native checks>=200ms on calling thread, max8 checks/512KiB prefix per SMT file; max16 bvurem fragments+80 return addresses; serialization overhead is diagnostic only and outside native check clock

claim_boundaries: One observed slow query is unique_value/refine/branch and contains no rem/div operators; does not prove all queries lack remainder.
No overall performance or convergence claim is made from a canceled30s diagnostic.
Thread stack samples are observations, not statistical CPU profiles.
Completed native check CPU8.7156s and processCPU30.1323s belong to the same instrumented run; remaining CPU includes many phases and instrumentation and is not assigned wholly to one cause.
